# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus is a large bulk of mixed WhatsApp-call transcripts. Only a minority are genuine **sales/enquiry/rate/order calls**; the rest are internal logistics chatter (loading, drivers, e-way bill/GST system issues, gift-distribution to dealers, bill-copy/payment follow-ups, HR/personal talk) which has been excluded here. The usable sales signal comes from roughly 40-50 calls where a customer/dealer asks for a **rate**, a **product spec**, places/confirms an **order**, or negotiates **price/discount/delivery**. Within that smaller set, patterns repeat strongly enough (same brands, same price bands, same objection types) to build a reliable playbook. This is **not** a large, diverse sample — treat the price figures as indicative of the period captured, not as a permanent price list.

Crayon Roofing & Structures is **not a fixing/fabrication contractor**. It is a **supply-only distributor** (confirmed explicitly: "Fixing எதுவும் பண்றது கிடையாது. Supply மட்டும் பண்ணிட்டு இருக்கோம் sir") based in Manali, Chennai, dealing mainly in **JSW-brand metal roofing sheets** and associated accessories, plus a Tata-brand hardware line.

## Products & brand ladder

**Core product: Pre-painted/Galvalume metal roofing sheets**, sold either by **square meter** or by **kg** (customer's choice, but kg-basis is discouraged internally because actual rolled weight runs "extra" and under-quotes the job).

Brand/quality ladder (cheapest → premium), as described live to customers:
1. **Indira Dhanush (JSW)** – entry-level, AZ 70/AZ 150 coating, thickness ~0.40–0.45mm. Cheapest line, colors limited (sky blue, off white/half white mainly).
2. **Pragathi / Pragathi Plus (JSW)** – mid-range; colors mostly **sky blue and off white only** ("Pragathi-ல sky blue off white மட்டும் தான் இருக்கும்"); no grey/brick-red/green kept in stock normally — special/large orders (≥10 ton) sourced externally.
3. **Silver On / Silver On Plus** – AZ150, plain/bare galvalume sheet, sold by kg, used for plain (non-colored) sheet requirements, 3.45m length common cut.
4. **JSW Color On Plus** – flagship line. Full color range available ("sky blue off white grey blue red எல்லாமே இருக்கும்"), two main thicknesses quoted: **0.47mm (AZ150)** and **0.50mm (AZ150)**, both carrying the **same warranty** (15 years) — only thickness/price differs, not warranty.
5. **Radiance Color One Plus** – another JSW-family SKU, colors limited to sky blue + half white, 0.60mm also offered.

**Other SKUs actively sold:**
- **PUF (Puff) roof panels** – 50mm thickness, quoted at ₹1600+GST per sq meter, top/bottom skin thickness specified separately, loading charged extra.
- **Polycarbonate sheets** – 2mm standard, color/size (e.g., 12.5 ft length) made-to-order, not instantly dispatchable.
- **Decking sheets** – 0.8mm / 1mm / 1.2mm; 0.8mm often out of stock/needs MD production approval for small orders; 1mm/1.2mm more readily available.
- **Flashing / L-flash / ridge / capping accessories** – sold by running meter (standard length 2.5m per piece), converted to "numbers" (pieces) for billing; frequent confusion between mm/meter notation needs careful clarification with customers.
- **Tata-brand hardware**: welding rods/electrodes (2.5mm, 3.15mm, 4mm), self-tapping roofing screws (1", 1.5", 2", 2.5", stitch screws — single/double/full/off-thread variants), cutting & grinding wheels, CO2 welding wire coil.
- **Square tube / MS pipe** – mentioned in passing for a specific customer (NS Nithya), not a core focus.
